hypotheses.title: Gold Elevation: Fine-Tuning Turnover and Lookback to Elevate 8-PASS Alphas to GOOD and EXCELLENT Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Leverages our two breakthrough 8/8 PASS alphas from Batch 53 (Card 3: Sharpe 1.87, Fitness 1.50, Self-corr 0.6974; Card 4: Sharpe 1.89, Fitness 1.31, Self-corr 0.6448). Mathematically compresses turnover from 17-18% down to 10-13% to increase the Fitness multiplier (Fitness = Sharpe * sqrt(Returns / Turnover)) past 1.60 (GOOD) and into 1.80+ (EXCELLENT): (1) Card 3 with Decay=8: Smoothes weight decay to drop turnover to ~12% on the proven 8-PASS engine. (2) Card 3 with 10% 10-Day Reversal: Replaces weekly 15% reversal with biweekly 10% reversal to cut trading costs and lift Fitness. (3) Super Alpha with 252d FX Lookback and Decay=6: Upgrades Card 4 by restoring the proven annual 252d FX signal and applying quadratic conviction. (4) Proven FX Currency Hedging in TOP1000 with Decay=6: Compresses turnover on the low-correlation (0.5602) FX alpha to lift Fitness into the GOOD tier.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if institutional options demand reflects hedging panic rather than informed directional conviction.
